        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        Solver solver = new Solver();

        out.close();

    static class Solver {
        static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
        static final long INF = (long)1e18 + 1;
        long[][] nCr = new long[100][100];

        long comb(long base, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
            base = (base * nCr[a][b]) % MOD;
            base = (base * nCr[c][d]) % MOD;
            return base;
        }

        void solve(int testNum, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = in.nextInt();
            int K = in.nextInt();
            int cnt50 = 0, cnt100 = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (in.nextInt() == 50) cnt50++;
                else cnt100++;
            }

            // Precompute binomial coefficients
            for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                    if (j == 0 || j == i) nCr[i][j] = 1;
                    else nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
                }
            }

            long[][][] dist = new long[200][200][2];
            long[][][] ways = new long[200][200][2];
            for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dist[i][j], INF);
                    Arrays.fill(ways[i][j], 0);
                }
            }

            dist[0][0][0] = 0;
            ways[0][0][0] = 1;

            Deque<State> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
            queue.add(new State(0, 0, 0, 0));

            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                State cur = queue.poll();
                int x = cur.x;
                int y = cur.y;
                int side = cur.side;
                long d = dist[x][y][side];

                if (side == 0) {
                    int rem50 = cnt50 - x;
                    int rem100 = cnt100 - y;
                    for (int take50 = 0; take50 <= rem50; take50++) {
                        for (int take100 = 0; take100 <= rem100; take100++) {
                            if (take50 == 0 && take100 == 0) continue;
                            int weight = take50 * 50 + take100 * 100;
                            if (weight > K) break;
                            int nx = x + take50;
                            int ny = y + take100;
                            int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                            if (dist[nx][ny][nextSide] >= d + 1) {
                                if (dist[nx][ny][nextSide] > d + 1) {
                                    dist[nx][ny][nextSide] = d + 1;
                                    queue.add(new State(nx, ny, nextSide, d + 1));
                                    ways[nx][ny][nextSide] = (ways[nx][ny][nextSide] + comb(ways[x][y][side], rem50, take50, rem100, take100)) % MOD;
                                } else {
                                    ways[nx][ny][nextSide] = (ways[nx][ny][nextSide] + comb(ways[x][y][side], rem50, take50, rem100, take100)) % MOD;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    int rem50 = x;
                    int rem100 = y;
                    for (int take50 = 0; take50 <= rem50; take50++) {
                        for (int take100 = 0; take100 <= rem100; take100++) {
                            if (take50 == 0 && take100 == 0) continue;
                            int weight = take50 * 50 + take100 * 100;
                            if (weight > K) break;
                            int nx = x - take50;
                            int ny = y - take100;
                            int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                            if (dist[nx][ny][nextSide] >= d + 1) {

                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                out.println(-1);
            } else {
                out.println(dist[cnt50][cnt100][1]);
            }
            out.println(ways[cnt50][cnt100][1]);
        }

        static class State {
            int x, y, side;
            long dist;
            State(int x, int y, int side, long dist) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.side = side;
                this.dist = dist;
            }
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];
        private int ptr = 0, len = 0;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        private int read() {
            if (len == -1) throw new RuntimeException();
            if (ptr >= len) {
                ptr = 0;
                try { len = stream.read(buffer); } catch (IOException e) { throw new RuntimeException(); }
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = read();

            int val = 0;
            for (; !isSpace(c); c = read()) {

            return val;
